There are two distinct rotor assemblies visible: one on the left with a silver, multi-spoke design and a red/silver caliper, and one on the right with a similar rotor design but featuring yellow accents and a black/yellow caliper. Black hydraulic hoses connect the calipers to the rest of the assembly. The background is a textured wood grain.
